# QuestionField

## Summary

QuestionField is one assignment question: `cardTitle` (the question's short name), `questionText` (markdown prompt), `answer` (the student's markdown answer, edited inline from the isolated view), `maxPoints`, and a computed `isAnswered`. The grader holds questions in a `containsMany`, and the AI awards `questionPoints[i]` / writes `questionFeedbacks[i]` against the same index.

## Usage as a Field

```ts
@field questions = containsMany(QuestionField);
```

## Template Usage

```handlebars
{{#each @model.questions as |q|}}{{q.cardTitle}}{{/each}}
```

Each question renders with its own embedded and fitted views; the fitted view embeds an editable answer field.
